title: Repair alternating blocks from sorted extremes
goal: Implement alternating_extreme_blocks(items, block_size) for a list of integers and an integer block_size. Sort a copy of items. Take up to block_size of the remaining smallest elements in ascending order, then up to block_size of the remaining largest elements in descending order, alternating whole blocks until no elements remain. Start with the smallest block. Every occurrence, including duplicates, must appear exactly once. A final partial block follows the same ordering rule. Empty items returns []. A non-positive block_size raises ValueError even for empty input. Do not mutate items.
constraints: Only edit solution.py; do not add files or dependencies or modify tests.
Keep the public function name and two-argument signature unchanged.
Assume items is a list of integers and block_size is an integer.
